System

Capsule locomotion, sprint, jump, dodge and fall damage

Move freely on the X/Y ground plane, using Z for elevation. CharacterMovement remains the sole movement integrator. Sprint, jump and dodge consume approved intent/resources; art can have only four directions while collision remains fully three-dimensional.

Scope and player interaction

Move freely on the X/Y ground plane, using Z for elevation. CharacterMovement remains the sole movement integrator. Sprint, jump and dodge consume approved intent/resources; art can have only four directions while collision remains fully three-dimensional.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase02committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Grounded → Sprinting → Falling → Dodging → Recovering → Swimming → Dead → TravelLocked

WBP_HUD observes results from URPGCharacterMovementComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Movement_Default. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
WalkSpeedCmPerSecond=450; SprintSpeed=650; server-owned tunables
CapsuleRadiusCm=34 and HalfHeightCm=88; full-height collision, tune to world
JumpZVelocityCmPerSecond=420; air control is data-defined
DodgeDistanceCm=300; DurationSeconds=0.25; RecoverySeconds=0.35
SprintStaminaPerSecond=8 and DodgeStaminaCost=15; GAS resource owner after Phase 07
SafeFallHeightCm=300; damage curve keyed by server-measured fall distance
SavedMoveIntent: sprint/dodge flags and validated sequence; transient network movement data

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGCharacterMovementComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_HUDLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
SetMoveIntent(Axis2D) -> Cached; local input, normalized magnitude <=1
RequestSprint(bool) -> Predicted|Rejected; movement intent validated on server
RequestJump() and ReleaseJump() -> native Character jump path; no duplicate impulse
RequestDodge(Direction, SequenceId) -> Accepted|NoStamina|WrongMode|Blocked
HandleAuthoritativeLanding(FallDistanceCm) -> FallDamageEvent|NoDamage; server only

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Convert Axis2D into a fixed camera-ground forward/right basis. Normalize diagonal keyboard input without discarding analog magnitude.
  2. Feed AddMovementInput into CharacterMovement, not repeated SetActorLocation or a parallel Blueprint movement Tick.
  3. Extend saved-move prediction for sprint/dodge intent so a delayed reliable RPC cannot make speed state diverge from the move being simulated. This is a native implementation task requiring installed CMC API inspection.
  4. Server validates current movement mode, action permissions, stamina and displacement, then simulates the approved movement with capsule sweeps.
  5. Publish movement mode/velocity and accepted dodge sequence to presentation; no sprite notify changes location or restores a dodge budget.
  6. On landing, server computes the fall event once from its own grounded/falling history. GAS applies configured damage after Phase 07; Phase 02 logs the proposed event only.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. In BP_PlayerCharacter disable plane constraint and yaw rotation driven by sprite facing. Retain capsule collision against WorldStatic/WorldDynamic as appropriate; sprite components have NoCollision.
  2. Set camera-relative input as Axis2D in IA_Move and map W/S to forward/back and A/D to right/left with the appropriate negate/swizzle modifiers. Confirm values in the input debugger rather than assuming template axis conventions.
  3. Create URPGCharacterMovementComponent as the native movement replacement at character construction; do not add a second movement component in Blueprint. Header/signature edits require a full Editor-closed compile.
  4. Set MaxStepHeight=35 cm and WalkableFloorAngle=40° initially. In L_TerrainLab author stairs at 20/35/45 cm and slopes at 15/30/45° to establish pass/fail boundaries.
  5. Bind Jump Started to the one native Jump route and release/cancel to StopJumping. Bind sprint and dodge to intent APIs; remove legacy coyote/buffer/second-jump platformer paths unless separately designed.
  6. Reopen the movement extension in Phase 07 to replace temporary stamina fixture values with the PlayerState ASC; replay movement tests after that dependency change.

Reopen Phase02 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_TerrainLab / Ramp30 / Stairs20 / Bridge / FallPit. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Diagonal full keyboard input -> same top speed as straight input, not sqrt(2) faster.
Dodge into a wall or bridge rail -> capsule stops/slides under collision; no teleport through it.
Sprint packet arrives late -> saved move/prediction corrects state; no permanent speed increase.
Jump repeated in air -> rejected under one-jump policy; changing sprite direction adds no jump.
Death/travel while key held -> input cleared, dodge canceled, no stale action replay after respawn.
Fall below kill floor -> one death/recovery event, never an inventory rollback.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

All listed speeds, capsule dimensions, slopes, stamina and timings are tuning proposals. Start with native jump behavior; do not recreate platformer coyote time or climbing. No climb action is bound.

Record authoritative position/mode, correction distance, action sequence and rejection reason. Test at 30/60/120 fps and 0/80/160 ms latency profiles after Phase 03; those are recipes, not measured results.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
